description: This file defines a React functional component called ChatBox, which provides a user interface for a simple chat application. It manages user input, displays messages, handles sending messages to a backend, and shows loading states and errors.

methods.name: ChatBox
methods.description: React functional component implementing a chat interface with message state management, input handling, and backend communication.

methods.name: onSend
methods.description: Asynchronous function triggered when user sends a message; updates message list, manages loading and error states, and communicates with backend via sendMessage.
